about: Inspired by a desire to both connect more deeply with nature and explore new mediums, this project uses photogrammetry to breathe new life into local flora creating 3D models that move and animate to the sound of music.

By turning the frequencies of plants into music and blending it with nature sounds and original vocals, a unique co-creation between plant and human emerges showing us that technology can enable us to commune with the natural world in novel and intimate ways.
processIntro: Through a multi-step process that started out by seeking and selecting the most striking local flora, the flora was then scanned in 3D to capture its intricate form. Finally, the model was refined to bring out unique qualities of the flower to appear both realistic and otherworldly.

process.title: Turning plant frequencies into music using a PlantWave device
process.body: The music was crafted first by generating a bass line directly from the flora using a device called PlantWave which turns plant frequencies into music. With the bass line as inspiration, additional texture was layered on such as local nature sounds and original vocals inspired by the energy of the plants themselves.

final.title: Final Piece
final.body: The project culminates in a concept combining tech and nature to co-create in deep connection. With inspiration drawn from local flora, music generated by the plants themselves, 3D modeling, and surrealism, the possibility emerges to commune deeply with and embrace the creative potential of our natural surroundings.
